item.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. campaign to ban child marriage?
item.description: The global effort to end child marriage is in the news. In the U.S., there's a new bill before Congress (but it's controversial). And the U.N. is designating a day dedicated to ending the practice.

item.title: With jury deadlocked, Judge declares a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case
item.description: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's murder case has declared a mistrial after the jury was unable to agree on a verdict.

item.title: No wonder 'Coyote vs. Acme' is resonating. It's about runaway corporate power
item.description: Blending live action with animation, Coyote vs. Acme is a spoof of the classic legal thriller. Think The Verdict or Erin Brockovich — but steeped in the surreal anarchy of Looney Tunes.

item.title: Who owns the beach? A heated battle plays out in the Florida Panhandle
